prompt: Create a GET endpoint to list evidence collections. Filter by session, creator, tags. Paginated. Return 200.
spec_yaml:
task_id: get-evidence-collections-endpoint
summary: "Implement a GET endpoint to list evidence collections with filtering and pagination"
depends_on: ["stage-1-core-models", "stage-2-pipeline"]
local_goals:
  - id: L1
    description: "INSPECT: check existing evidence model and routes before adding new endpoints"
    verification:
      type: file_exists
      path: "src/models/EvidenceCollection.ts"
      expect:
        exists: true
  - id: L2
    description: "INSPECT: check existing API routes structure"
    verification:
      type: cli
      command: "cat apps/api/src/routes/evidenceCollections.ts"
      expect:
        exit_code: 0
  - id: L3
    description: "CREATE: add GET /v1/evidence-collections endpoint with filtering and pagination"
    verification:
      type: cli
      command: "pnpm build --filter=@verified-attention/api"
      expect:
        exit_code: 0
  - id: L4
    description: "VERIFY: GET /v1/evidence-collections returns evidence collections filtered by session, creator, and tags"
    verification:
      type: http
      method: GET
      url: http://localhost:3000/v1/evidence-collections?session_id={{session_id}}&creator={{creator_id}}&tags=tag1,tag2&page=1&pageSize=10
      headers:
        Authorization: "Bearer {test_token}"
      expect:
        status: 200
        json_schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            evidenceCollections: 
              type: array
              items:
                type: object
                properties:
                  id: { type: string }
                  session_id: { type: string }
                  creator_id: { type: string }
                  tags: { type: array, items: { type: string } }
          required: [evidenceCollections]
  - id: L5
    description: "VERIFY: GET /v1/evidence-collections returns paginated results"
    verification:
      type: http
      method: GET
      url: http://localhost:3000/v1/evidence-collections?page=2&pageSize=10
      headers:
        Authorization: "Bearer {test_token}"
      expect:
        status: 200
        json_schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            evidenceCollections: 
              type: array
              items:
                type: object
                properties:
                  id: { type: string }
                  session_id: { type: string }
                  creator_id: { type: string }
                  tags: { type: array, items: { type: string } }
          required: [evidenceCollections]
global_goals_refs: ["G5", "G13"]

  language: TypeScript

  orm: Prisma
  test_framework: Vitest

prompt: Create a scheduled task that validates all external service SLAs (latency, availability). Alert on breach. Dashboard.
spec_yaml:
task_id: validate-external-service-slas
summary: "Validate all external service SLAs and alert on breaches with a dashboard"
depends_on: ["stage-1-core-models", "stage-2-pipeline"]
local_goals:
  - id: L1
    description: "INSPECT: check existing SLA validation script"
    verification:
      type: file_exists
      path: "scripts/validate-slas.js"
      expect:
        exists: true
  - id: L2
    description: "CREATE/MODIFY: add new external service SLA validation endpoints in the API"
    verification:
      type: cli
      command: "pnpm build --filter=@verified-attention/api"
      expect:
        exit_code: 0
  - id: L3
    description: "VERIFY: POST /v1/slas/validate creates a new SLA validation task"
    verification:
      type: http
      method: POST
      url: http://localhost:3000/v1/slas/validate
      headers:
        Authorization: "Bearer {test_token}"
      body:
        serviceId: "external-service-id"
        latencyThreshold: 500
        availabilityThreshold: 99.9
      expect:
        status: 201
        json_schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            taskId: { type: string }
          required: [taskId]
  - id: L4
    description: "VERIFY: GET /v1/slas/validate/:id returns the SLA validation result"
    verification:
      type: http
      method: GET
      url: http://localhost:3000/v1/slas/validate/{task_id}
      headers:
        Authorization: "Bearer {test_token}"
      expect:
        status: 200
        json_schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            taskId: { type: string }
            serviceId: { type: string }
            latencyResult: { type: string }
            availabilityResult: { type: string }
          required: [taskId, serviceId, latencyResult, availabilityResult]
  - id: L5
    description: "CREATE/MODIFY: add alerting mechanism for SLA breaches"
    verification:
      type: cli
      command: "pnpm build --filter=@verified-attention/alerts"
      expect:
        exit_code: 0
  - id: L6
    description: "VERIFY: Alert is sent when SLA breach occurs"
    verification:
      type: manual
      description: "Manually check the alerting system for a notification when an SLA breach is detected."
  - id: L7
    description: "CREATE/MODIFY: add dashboard to visualize SLA validation results and alerts"
    verification:
      type: cli
      command: "pnpm build --filter=@verified-attention/dashboard"
      expect:
        exit_code: 0
  - id: L8
    description: "VERIFY: Dashboard displays SLA validation results and alerts"
    verification:
      type: manual
      description: "Manually check the dashboard to ensure it correctly displays SLA validation results and alerts."
global_goals_refs: ["G5", "G13"]

  framework: Express
  orm: Prisma
  test_framework: Vitest

prompt: Add a GET endpoint for user's public profile (limited fields). Respect privacy settings. Return 404 if private or user not found.
spec_yaml:
task_id: user-public-profile-api
summary: "REST API for retrieving a user's public profile with privacy settings respected"
depends_on: ["stage-1-core-models", "stage-2-auth-middleware"]
local_goals:
  - id: L1
    description: "INSPECT: check existing user model and routes before adding endpoints"
    verification:
      type: file_exists
      path: "src/models/User.ts"
      expect:
        exists: true
  - id: L2
    description: "INSPECT: check existing API routes structure"
    verification:
      type: cli
      command: "cat apps/api/src/routes/users.ts"
      expect:
        exit_code: 0
  - id: L3
    description: "CREATE: add GET /v1/users/:id endpoint for public profile retrieval"
    verification:
      type: cli
      command: "pnpm build --filter=@verified-attention/api"
      expect:
        exit_code: 0
  - id: L4
    description: "VERIFY: GET /v1/users/:id returns the user's public profile with privacy settings respected"
    verification:
      type: http
      method: GET
      url: http://localhost:3000/v1/users/{user_id}
      headers:
        Authorization: "Bearer {test_token}"
      expect:
        status: 200
        json_schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            userId: { type: string }
            username: { type: string }
            email: { type: string }
            bio: { type: string }
          required: [userId, username, email]
  - id: L5
    description: "VERIFY: GET /v1/users/:id returns 404 if user not found"
    verification:
      type: http
      method: GET
      url: http://localhost:3000/v1/users/{nonexistent_user_id}
      headers:
        Authorization: "Bearer {test_token}"
      expect:
        status: 404
